en.neural_next_steps_body: The multidimensional model converts the recommendation into a bounded sequence with dependencies and approval gates.
en.neural_step_human_gate: Human approval is required before activation.
en.neural_step_protect_urgent_scope: Protect the urgent scope and exclude non-essential work
en.neural_step_define_target_market: Define one priority market and visitor profile
en.neural_step_audit_priority_pages: Audit the highest-value website pages and trust signals
en.neural_step_apply_30_day_fixes: Approve and apply the prioritised 30-day fixes
en.neural_step_consolidate_leads: Consolidate current leads into one controlled source
en.neural_step_define_pipeline_ownership: Define pipeline stages, ownership and next-action rules
en.neural_step_activate_follow_up_rhythm: Approve and activate the follow-up operating rhythm
en.neural_step_select_primary_audience: Select the primary international audience and use case
en.neural_step_collect_commercial_proof: Collect proof, differentiators and objection evidence
en.neural_step_draft_bilingual_one_pager: Approve the structure and build the bilingual one-pager

en.neural_step_prepare_inputs: Prepare the evidence package for human approval

es.neural_step_protect_urgent_scope: Proteger el alcance urgente y excluir trabajo no esencial

es.neural_step_consolidate_leads: Consolidar los leads actuales en una única fuente controlada
es.neural_step_define_pipeline_ownership: Definir etapas, responsables y reglas de siguiente acción
es.neural_step_activate_follow_up_rhythm: Aprobar y activar el ritmo operativo de seguimiento
es.neural_step_select_primary_audience: Seleccionar la audiencia internacional y el caso de uso principal
es.neural_step_collect_commercial_proof: Recopilar pruebas, diferenciadores y evidencia de objeciones
